_note: 學習路徑內容第25批 #6／6：不定詞意義主詞 for sb to / of sb to（eng.t_adv.nonfinite.subject-of-infinitive，學測級／高階）。不定詞的『意義主詞』用 for + 受詞引導：It is important for the children to learn this；We are waiting for the rain to stop。形容人品格/行為的形容詞（kind/nice/rude/clever/silly/generous）用 of + 受詞：It was kind of you to help。判別法：形容詞能直接形容人（You were kind to help）→用 of；形容詞形容情境（important/easy/difficult/necessary）→用 for。誘答鎖『for/of 互換（忽略形容詞類別）／缺介系詞／該不定詞卻用 -ing』等結構性錯誤；of↔for 的對比以語意差異（非絕對錯）說明，不 overstate。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix soi_）。

units.title_zh: 不定詞意義主詞（for sb to／of sb to）
units.can_do: 我能用 for + 受詞引導不定詞的意義主詞，並在形容人品格的形容詞（kind/rude…）後改用 of + 受詞，掌握 for 與 of 的判別。
units.situation_group: 非限定動詞：不定詞的意義主詞
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The logical subject of an infinitive is usually introduced by 'for + object': 'It is easy for her to learn languages.' / 'I opened the door for the cat to come in.'
claims.verification_ref: 不定詞的意義主詞一般用 for + 受詞（It is easy for her to learn...）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 代入朗讀複核

claims.text: With adjectives that describe a person's character or behavior (kind, nice, good, rude, clever, silly, generous), use 'of + object': 'It was very kind of you to help.'
claims.verification_ref: 形容人品格/行為的形容詞（kind/nice/rude/clever/silly/generous）後用 of + 受詞（It was kind of you to help）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Use 'of' when the adjective can also describe the person directly ('You were kind to help' -> 'It was kind of you to help'). Use 'for' with adjectives that describe the situation, such as 'important', 'easy', 'difficult' or 'necessary': 'It is important for you to rest.'
claims.verification_ref: 判別：形容詞能直接形容人→of；形容情境（important/easy/difficult/necessary）→for；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'For + object + to-infinitive' also shows who performs the action after some verbs and nouns: 'We are waiting for the bus to arrive.'
claims.verification_ref: for + 受詞 + to V 也用於某些動詞/名詞後標出動作者（waiting for the bus to arrive）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The logical subject of an infinitive (who does the action) is usually shown by 'for + object'.
teach.zh_hint: 不定詞動作的「意義主詞」（是誰做的）一般用 for + 受詞來引導。

teach.body: It is important for students to ask questions.
teach.zh_hint: 學生發問是很重要的。for students 標出『是誰』該發問。

teach.body: With adjectives that describe a person's character or behavior (kind, nice, good, rude, clever, silly, generous), use 'of + object'.
teach.zh_hint: 形容人品格或行為的形容詞（kind、nice、good、rude…）後面改用 of + 受詞。

teach.body: It was very nice of you to invite me.
teach.zh_hint: 你邀請我真好。nice 形容你的好意→用 of you。

teach.body: Quick test: if the adjective can describe the person directly, use 'of'; if it describes the situation (important, easy, difficult), use 'for'.
teach.zh_hint: 判別法：形容詞能直接形容人→用 of；形容情境（important／easy／difficult）→用 for。

teach.body: It was silly of him to forget, but it is easy for anyone to make that mistake.
teach.zh_hint: 他忘記很傻，但任何人都容易犯這個錯。silly 形容他→of him；easy 形容情境→for anyone。

teach.body: 'For + object' also follows some verbs, like 'wait', to show who or what does the action: We are waiting for the bus to arrive.
teach.zh_hint: for + 受詞 也接在某些動詞（如 wait）後面，標出『誰／什麼』做這個動作：We are waiting for the bus to arrive.（等公車來）。

practice.stem: 選正確：It is important ____ to wear a helmet.（important 形容情境→意義主詞用 for）

distractor_rationales.of cyclists: of 用在形容人品格的形容詞（kind/rude…）後；important 是形容情境，意義主詞用 for。
distractor_rationales.to cyclists: 引導意義主詞用 for，不是 to。
distractor_rationales.cyclists: 少了介系詞；要用 for cyclists 引導意義主詞。

practice.feedback: important for cyclists to wear...：情境形容詞用 for + 受詞。

practice.stem: 選正確：It was very kind ____ to carry my bags.（kind 形容人的品格→用 of）

distractor_rationales.for you: kind 形容你的品格（You were kind），這類形容詞用 of you，不用 for you。
distractor_rationales.to you: 此處引導意義主詞/表品格用 of，不是 to。
distractor_rationales.you: 少了介系詞；要用 of you。

practice.feedback: kind of you to carry...：品格形容詞（kind）用 of + 受詞。

practice.stem: 選正確：We are still waiting ____ to stop.（等待某事發生）

distractor_rationales.of the rain: wait 後面接 for；標出動作者用 for the rain，不用 of。
distractor_rationales.the rain: 少了 for；wait for + 受詞 + to V。
distractor_rationales.for the rain's: 不用所有格；直接用 for the rain to stop。

practice.feedback: waiting for the rain to stop：for + 受詞 + to V 標出動作者。

practice.stem: 選正確：It was ____ to lend me the money when I was broke.（generous 形容人的慷慨）

distractor_rationales.generous for them: generous 形容他們的品格（They were generous），這類形容詞用 of them，不用 for them。
distractor_rationales.generous to them: generous to them 意思是『對他們很慷慨』（他們是受惠者）；本句要說『他們很慷慨地借錢』，動作者用 of them。
distractor_rationales.generous them: 少了介系詞；要用 of them。

practice.feedback: generous of them to lend...：品格形容詞（generous）用 of + 受詞。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（你願意幫忙真好）
practice.answer: It was good of you to help.
options: It was good of you to help.
It was good for you to help.
It was good you to help.
It was good of you helping.

good for you to help 偏向『幫忙對你有好處』；本句要稱讚你的好意（品格），要用 good of you。
少了介系詞；要用 good of you。
這個結構接不定詞 to help，不接 -ing helping。

practice.feedback: good of you to help：稱讚品格用 of + 受詞 + to V。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: It was very kind of you to help me.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：kind of you（品格用 of）、to help me、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。for／of 輕讀、to V 連讀、句尾下收。
